paite: Paikan Ankuanglui kipat ma in, Jesu'n hiai khovel nusia a Pa kiang a apai hun hong tungta chih athei a; khovel a a-itte, atawp pha in a-it hi.
heading: Jesu'n Nungzuite Khe Asil
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

paite: Huan nitak an nek lai a, diabol in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot, lungtang a Jesu zuausan a matsak lungsim akoihsak khit nung in,
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

paite: Pa'n akhut ah thil bangkim apeta chih leh Pathian a kipan hong pai ahi a, Pathian kiang a pai ding ahi chih, Jesu'n theigige in,
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

paite: nitak an um lai adingh a, apuante asuahkhia a, kinulna puan ala a, ateng hi.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

paite: Huan kisilna kuang ah tui asung a, nungzuite khe asilsak a, akinulna puanten in anul zel hi.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

paite: Huchi in Simon Peter kiang ah ahong a, "Toupa, nang tel in ka khe na sil dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih tu'n ah na thei kei; himahleh tunung chiang in na thei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Ka khe na sil kei hial ding," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na khe ka sil keileh ka kiang ah tan na nei kei ding," achi hi.
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

paite: Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, ka khe kia hilou in, ka khutte leh ka lutang leng aw," achi hi.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kisil khinsa akhe lou ngal sil akiphamoh kei, apumpi in asiang; nou na siang uh, na vek un zaw ahi kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

paite: Amansak dingpa athei ngal a; huaiziak in, "Na vek un zaw na siang kei uh," achi hi.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

paite: Huchi in akhete uh asil khit a, apuante alak a, atut nawn in akiang uah, "Na tung ua ka thilhih na thei uhia?" achi hi.
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

paite: "Nou, Toupa leh heutupa na hon chi ua; na chi dik uh, ka hihna mah ahi.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

paite: Kei Toupa leh na heutupa un na khe uh ka silleh noute'n leng na khe uh na kisilsak chiat ding uh ahi.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

paite: Na tung ua ka hih bang in, nou leng na hih sam ding un, hihdan ding hon hilh ka hi.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sikha apu sang in athupizaw kei a; sawl a om leng asawlpa sang in athupizaw sam kei hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

paite: Huai thilte na theih ua, na hih uleh minuamsa na hi uhi.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

paite: "Na vek ua thu ka gen kei a; ka telte ka thei; himahleh ka tanghou nepa'n ka tung ah akhetul alikta chih, Laisiangthou ahong tuntheihna ding ahi.
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

paite: Tu in ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi, ahong tun hun chiang a kei amah ka hi chih na gintakna ding un.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh ka sawl kipahpih, kei hon kipahpih ahi; kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih, hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

paite: Jesu'n huai thu agen khit in, alungsim amangbang a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat in kei hon mansak ding," chi in atheisakta hi.
heading: Jesu'n Matsak A A-om Ding Agenkhol
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

paite: Huan nungzuite'n achih pen athei kei ua, aki-entuah chiat uhi.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

paite: Anungzuite lak a khat, Jesu'n a-itpa, dohkan sik ah Jesu angsung ah kingai in a-om hi.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

paite: Simon Peter in huai mi kiang ah, kua pen thu ahia agen dong ding in akhutvan hi.
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

paite: Jesu awm ngai mah in a-awnphei a, akiang ah, "Toupa, kua pen ahia?" achi hi.
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Tanghou them ka diah a, ka piakpa ahi ding," chi in adawng hi. Huchi in tanghou them adiah zoh in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot in kiang ah apia hi.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

paite: Tanghou them apiak nung in asung ah Setan alutta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na hih ding hih meng in," achi hi.
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

paite: Dohkan a omte'n bang tum a hiai thu gen hiam chih athei kei uh.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

paite: Akhen in Judas in dangka ip akep ziak in, Jesu'n ankuangluina a ding thil kiphamoh peuh lei in, chi hiam, migentheite kiang ah banghiam piak ding, chi hiam asa uhi.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

paite: Huan tanghou them la in, apawtkhe pah a; huai tuh zan lai ahi.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

paite: Huaiziak in apawt nung in, Jesu'n agen a, "Tu in Mihing Tapa pahtawi in a-omta a, Pathian leng amah ziak in pahtawi in a-om hi.
heading: Thupiak Thak
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

paite: Amah a Pathian pahtawi a a-omleh amah leng Pathian mahmah in apahtawi ding a, apahtawi pahta ding hi.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

paite: Naute aw, hun tomchik na kiang uah ka om lai tadih hi. Nou na hon zong ding uh; Judate kiang a, ka paina ding ah nou na hong pai thei kei ding uh chih ka gen bang in, tu in huchi mah bang in na kiang uah ka gen ahi.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

paite: Thupiak thak ka hon pia ahi, ki-ittuah chiat un; ke'n nou ka hon it bang in, nou leng ki-ittuah un.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

paite: Na ki-ittuah uleh mi tengteng in ka nungzuite na hi uh chih hiai ah athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

paite: Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia? achi hi. Jesu'n, ka hohna ding ah nang tu in na hon zui thei kei ding; tunung chiang in zaw na hon zui ding," chi in adawng hi.
heading: Peter Kitheihmohbawl Ding Genkholhna / (Mat 26.31-35; Mar 14.27-31; Luk 22.31-34)
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, bang ding in ahia tua leng ka hon zuih theih louh ding? Nangmah ziak in ka hinna ka koihkhe ding," achi hi.
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Keimah ziak in na hinna na koihkhe ding maw? Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ma in ak akhuang kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
